configuration.title: Agorix Studio
config.serverUrl: Optional Agorix project server URL. Account tokens are stored in VS Code SecretStorage, never in settings.
config.agent.enabled: Allow Studio to ask the Learning Companion for help. Editing and running never depend on it.
config.agent.endpoint: Tutor API / adapter boundary endpoint (for example `http://127.0.0.1:8787`). Studio never talks to a model provider directly. Never put credentials here.
config.agent.remoteEndpoint: Optional remote tutor API endpoint. Ignored unless `agorixStudio.agent.allowRemote` is on. Never put credentials here.
config.agent.preferLocal: Try local (loopback) endpoints before remote ones.
config.agent.allowRemote: Explicit opt-in to contact a non-local endpoint. Off by default. Credentials, when a deployment needs them, are stored in VS Code SecretStorage via the `Set Agent Credential` command, never in settings.
config.agent.healthTimeoutMs: Timeout for the availability probe, in milliseconds.
config.agent.requestTimeoutMs: Timeout for a Learning Companion request, in milliseconds.
config.agent.layaEndpoint: Optional local LAYA decision endpoint. Studio calls `POST /decideMany` only for cheap proactive veto decisions. Remote endpoints require `agorixStudio.agent.allowRemote`.
config.agent.proposalBudgetRequests: Maximum AI-backed suggestions per Studio session. When the limit is reached Studio keeps offering built-in suggestions; editing and running are unaffected.
config.agent.ambientBudgetRequests: Maximum ambient proactive offers per Studio session. Editing, running and explicit Companion commands are unaffected.
config.workbench.density: Workbench UI density. `auto` starts comfortable and turns compact after a few edits or once the program reaches the goal; it only changes spacing and size and never hides anything. `compact` reduces spacing for IDE-style repeated editing while keeping controls keyboard accessible.
welcome.projects:
Agorix Studio

Start coding with Agorix.

[Create New Project](command:agorixStudio.createProject)
[Open .agorix Project](command:agorixStudio.openProject)
[Open Account Project](command:agorixStudio.openRemoteProject)

You can work locally without an account.

Agorix can suggest, explain and debug from your program and runtime evidence. Changes are never applied without your approval.
